lines.beaver_en: Hello. What kind of consultation would you like today?
lines.learner: 요즘 지출이 너무 많아서 줄이고 싶어요.
lines.en: My spending is too high lately, so I want to cut it.
lines.roman: yojeum jichuri neomu manaseo jurigo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Where do you usually spend the most?
lines.learner: 쇼핑을 자주 하고 할부로 많이 사요.
lines.en: I shop often and buy a lot in installments.
lines.roman: syopingeul jaju hago halburo mani sayo.

lines.beaver_en: How many installment plans do you have left?
lines.learner: 세 개요. 큰돈이 한꺼번에 나가서 힘들어요.
lines.en: Three. A large sum goes out at once, so it's hard.
lines.roman: se gaeyo. keundoni hankkeobeone nagaseo himdeureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have you paid anything late, by any chance?
lines.en: Yes, I even paid a late fee last month.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any other debts?
lines.learner: 카드 빚이 조금 있어요. 형편이 안 좋아요.
lines.en: I have some card debt. My situation isn't good.
lines.roman: kadeu biji jogeum isseoyo. hyeongpyeoni an joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Don't worry. There are ways to cut back.
lines.learner: 정말요? 제가 과소비를 하는 것 같아요.
lines.roman: jeongmallyo? jega gwasobireul haneun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 꼭 필요한 물건만 사는 게 중요해요.
lines.beaver_en: It's important to buy only what you really need.
lines.beaver_roman: kkok piryohan mulgeonman saneun ge jungyohaeyo.
lines.en: Right. I wanted too many things.

lines.beaver_en: Also, try keeping a household budget book every month.
lines.en: I'll keep a budget book and see where I waste money.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 작은 습관이 큰 차이를 만들어요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Small habits make a big difference.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. jageun seupgwani keun chaireul mandeureoyo.
lines.en: I learned that the price of overspending is high.

lines.beaver: 돈 관리에 대해 더 이야기해 보실래요?
lines.beaver_en: Would you like to talk more about managing money?
lines.beaver_roman: don gwallie daehae deo iyagihae bosillaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 먹고살려면 배워야죠. 다음 주에 올게요.
lines.en: Yes, I have to learn this to get by. I'll come next week.
lines.roman: ne, meokgosallyeomyeon baewoyajyo. daeum jue olgeyo.
